newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint down vs dollar, BCE Ecu, lira futures active.
newsitem.headline: Forint down vs dollar, BCE Ecu, lira futures active.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed weaker against the dollar on Wednesday in what dealers said was an active forex market.
The forint closed at 153.40 against the dollar, down from its opening of 153.20/30.
"There was an especially strong demand for the Ecu," said Ervin Csengeri of Inter-Europa Bank.
Foreign currency buying caused the forint to weaken some 10 pips from the central bank's bid, traders said.
On the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE), Ecu futures rose for all maturities and the dollar ended lower for all but September 1996.
Ecu and lira futures were the most popular in relatively high turnover of 4.48 billion forints.
